products.name: Pinecone
products.note: Vector database; RAG infrastructure; data residency options; enterprise security

profile_text.body:
Pinecone is a New York-based technology company founded in 2019 that provides a fully managed vector database built for AI applications. The company describes its product as capable of searching through billions of items for similar matches to any object in milliseconds, positioning it as infrastructure for the next generation of search.

Pinecone's core product is a vector database designed to support retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) workflows and broader AI development. The company describes writes as instantly searchable, indexing as automatic, and query performance as consistent at any scale. The product is offered with data residency options and enterprise security features, and is accessible via API.
